09 — Skills

Part IV · Extend · Difficulty: medium · 75 to 100 minutes · 8 graded cases

The agent starts reading instructions you wrote for it. A skill is a markdown file with a one-line description; the description travels with every request, the body only when you invoke it.
How it worksoverview.md — catalogue versus body, placeholders, and stacking
What to buildproblem.md — the contract, the graded claims, the hints
Full implementationexample.md — annotated, after an attempt
You editagent/skill.go, agent/cmd/agent/main.go
Submitkata submit 09

Done when

kata submit 09 reports 8/8, and this works against a real endpoint:

mkdir -p skills/deploy
printf -- '---\nname: deploy\ndescription: Deploy to a region.\n---\nDeploy to $0 in $1.\n' \
  > skills/deploy/SKILL.md
./agent -p "/deploy staging eu-west"
